aria-label.zh-CN: 滑块的可访问名称；range 模式下两个手柄在其后分别追加语言包中的起点、终点。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the handle. In range mode, the locale's start and end texts are appended for the two handles.

aria-labelledby.zh-CN: 引用标签元素的 id，作为手柄的可访问名称；range 模式下每个手柄再加上起点或终点。
aria-labelledby.en-US: The id of the labelling element, used as the handle's accessible name. In range mode each handle adds its start or end text.

aria-valuetext.zh-CN: 为当前值提供用户友好的名称。
aria-valuetext.en-US: A user-friendly name for the current value.

autofocus.zh-CN: 挂载后自动聚焦第一个滑块。
autofocus.en-US: Focuses the first handle on mount.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 非受控时的初始取值，未设置时为 `min`。
defaultValue.en-US: Initial value when uncontrolled. Defaults to `min`.

getAriaValueText.zh-CN: 为滑块的当前值提供用户友好的名称，参数为该滑块的值与顺序。
getAriaValueText.en-US: Provides a user-friendly name for the current value, called with the handle's value and its index.

handleDot.zh-CN: 滑块上的圆点，单个滑块传一个对象，range 时按手柄传数组。
handleDot.en-US: Dot on the handle: one object for a single handle, an array with one per handle for a range.

included.zh-CN: marks 不为空对象时有效，true 表示刻度为包含关系，false 表示并列。
included.en-US: Takes effect when marks is not empty. true makes the marks nested, false makes them independent.

marks.zh-CN: 刻度，key 为 number 且取值在闭区间 [min, max] 内，值为字符串或数字；自定义节点使用 renderMark。
marks.en-US: Marks. Keys are numbers in the closed range [min, max], values are strings or numbers; custom nodes go through renderMark.

renderMark.zh-CN: 渲染刻度标签，参数为 (value, label)；开启 tooltipOnMark 时标签与气泡各调用一次。不传时显示 label。
renderMark.en-US: Renders a mark label, called with (value, label); with tooltipOnMark it is called once for the label and once for the tooltip. Defaults to the label.

name.zh-CN: 原生表单提交时的字段名，落在每个手柄的 input 上；range 模式下两个 input 同名，依次提交两个值。
name.en-US: Field name submitted with a native form, set on each handle's input. In range mode both inputs share it and submit two values in order.

onAfterChange.zh-CN: 值变化完成后触发，参数为当前取值；受控值被改回 `undefined` 时不触发。
onAfterChange.en-US: Fires after a change is complete, with the current value. Not fired when a controlled value goes back to `undefined`.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开两个手柄时触发，挂在 `.semi-slider-wrapper` 上；在两个手柄之间移动焦点不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Fires when focus leaves both handles, attached to `.semi-slider-wrapper`. Moving focus between the two handles does not fire it.

onChange.zh-CN: 值变化时触发，参数为当前取值。
onChange.en-US: Fires when the value changes, with the current value.

onFocus.zh-CN: 任一手柄获得焦点时触发，挂在 `.semi-slider-wrapper` 上。
onFocus.en-US: Fires when either handle gets focus, attached to `.semi-slider-wrapper`.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 手柄 input 上的按键回调，先于滑块处理；在回调中调用 `preventDefault` 可拦截取值键。
onKeyDown.en-US: Key handler on the handle's input, called before the slider handles the key. Calling `preventDefault` in it stops the slider from handling a value key.

onMouseUp.zh-CN: 拖动滑块的指针（鼠标、触摸、触控笔）松开或被取消时，以及取值键松开时触发。
onMouseUp.en-US: Fires when the pointer (mouse, touch or pen) that dragged the handle is released or cancelled, and when a value key is released.

railStyle.zh-CN: 滑块轨道的样式，可传对象（键为 CSS 属性名）或字符串。
railStyle.en-US: Style of the slider rail, an object keyed by CSS property names or a string.

range.zh-CN: 是否支持两端同时可滑动。
range.en-US: Whether both ends can be dragged.

showArrow.en-US: Whether the tooltip has an arrow.

showBoundary.zh-CN: 是否在悬停时展示最大值与最小值。
showBoundary.en-US: Whether to show the maximum and minimum on hover.

showMarkLabel.en-US: Whether to show the mark labels.

tipFormatter.zh-CN: 设置提示的展示格式，每个手柄单独调用，参数为该手柄的值；默认显示当前取值，`null` 隐藏提示。
tipFormatter.en-US: Format of the tooltip, called once per handle with that handle's value. Shows the current value by default; `null` hides the tooltip.

tooltipOnMark.en-US: Whether the marks on the rail have a tooltip.

tooltipVisible.en-US: Whether the tooltip is always visible.

value.zh-CN: 当前取值，受控使用；只传 value 而不在 onChange 中回写时，拖动、点击与方向键仅触发 onChange，滑块不移动。变回 `undefined` 时回到 defaultValue，没有则回到 min，且不触发 onAfterChange。
value.en-US: Current value, for controlled use. With value but no write-back in onChange, dragging, clicking and arrow keys only fire onChange and the handle does not move. Back to `undefined` it returns to defaultValue, or min without one, and onAfterChange does not fire.

verticalReverse.zh-CN: 反转垂直方向，即上大下小。
verticalReverse.en-US: Reverses the vertical direction, so the larger value is on top.
